$comment: Repo-level MCP server configuration for Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP-aware clients. VS Code Copilot uses the matching project entry in .vscode/mcp.json.

codegraph.$comment: CodeGraph — semantic code intelligence: symbol lookup, callers/callees, route mapping. In MCP mode CodeGraph uses the client's workspace root, so this config is portable across clones and machines. See docs/guides/MCP_SETUP.md.
